facts.label: Past progressive
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação em andamento e o passado simples para o evento curto: I was singing when the lights went out.

facts.label: Ação em andamento
facts.sub: Para falar de uma ação em andamento no passado, use was/were + -ing: The band was playing. Everyone was singing. Use was com I, he, she, it e were com you, we, they.

facts.label: Evento curto
facts.sub: Para um evento curto, use o passado simples: The lights went out. A girl dropped her drink. Junte os dois com when: I was standing near the stage when the lights went out.

pages.title: A sunny cafe · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday morning in a sunny cafe in Sydney. Bia sits with her coffee and a small ticket. Her friend Henry walks in. He sees the ticket on the table. Bia looks tired but very happy. Henry sits down and asks about last night.
“Hi, Bia! How was the concert?” says Henry. “It was great! The band was playing my favorite song when I arrived.” says Bia. “Lucky you! Where were you standing?” says Henry.
